svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Ratio 1: the read keeps pace with the write. The delay holds, and the pitch is unchanged.
Ratio 0.5: the read moves half as fast and falls behind. The delay grows, and the pitch drops an octave.
Ratio 2: the read moves twice as fast and catches up. At delay 0 it can go no further.
